item.title: The phone book that led us to Assad's spy chief in hiding
item.description:
📝 Inside, in scribbled blue handwriting, we found dozens of names - from shopkeepers and doctors, to military officials and people with the Luka family name. Some are believed to have been granted safe transit out of the city by Luka, but others who called the number were never seen or heard from again, according to several people we spoke to, including al-Zaydi. "Twenty-eight people were killed, including 17 children and four women, according to the Syrian Network for Human Rights.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c4gyrzn8p94o

item.title: Retraction: The App Store Rejection of the Week That Was a Correct Rejection
item.description:
📝 It was rejected on the grounds that it was astrology. You can now see the problem that has led me to fully retract my original post, given that my post was entirely predicated on the premise that Godier’s original description of the rejected app was true — that the app “has no tarot function, no horoscopes, and nothing that I, or anyone else I’ve asked, would associate with astrology. Godier’s astrology app that he submitted to the App Store back in January was named “Asterly”.
🔗 Read more: https://daringfireball.net/2026/08/retraction_app_store_rejection_of_the_week

item.title: ChatGPT starts blocking direct requests to copy an author's style
item.description:
📝 Text settings Story text Size Small Standard Large Width * Standard Wide Links Standard Orange * Subscribers only Learn more Minimize to nav OpenAI’s ChatGPT is now refusing requests to generate text that directly mimics the style of famous authors. An analysis published by No Latency earlier this month found the same behavior for living authors but found ChatGPT complied with style-copying requests for deceased authors. Not all major LLMs treat these style imitation requests the same way, though.
🔗 Read more: https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/07/chatgpt-stops-cloning-famous-writers-voices-but-may-capture-a-similar-feeling/
